comment: Releases made in chatraweechai/doc-scanner-pdf-android before the merge into chatraweechai/doc-scanner-pdf (2026-10-22). Their tags cannot be pushed from a session, so tools/release/version.js uses these commits as the release tags, and .github/workflows/releases-import.yml copies each release into this repository (tag at this commit; files checked against these SHA-256s and, for APKs, the signing certificate). v1.0.20: its GitHub Release was lost with the original account and its files are not in the former repository - they are attached to the copied release by hand (see handoff.md).
